title: Alcohol Prevention in Teens
subtitle: Age-appropriate education, prevention, risk reduction, and support related to alcohol prevention in teens.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports many educational and family-based prevention strategies; moderate evidence exists regarding long-term community policy impacts; emerging evidence around novel digital intervention tools; some uncertainties remain about the impact of cultural variability on program effectiveness.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
